Fix pages_needed for every u32 input. Return None for a zero page size, otherwise return the mathematical ceiling of items / page_size without overflow or panic. Zero items requires zero pages. Keep the public signature.

Edit ONLY src/lib.rs. Do not add tests, change Cargo files, add dependencies, suppress lints, use unsafe code or access hidden/reference files. Validation is requested through the experiment controller; do not execute commands yourself.

Use only the supplied tools. The editable closure is src/lib.rs; Cargo.toml and Cargo.lock are immutable. Submit each complete repair with submit_patch, or each choice with submit_selection. Use object arguments for admitted tools; missing or extra object fields receive retryable denials. Unknown tools or non-object arguments terminate the run. Use submit_selection evidence for the requested MSRV, license, caveat, snapshot_fingerprint, provenance source_id and corpus date. You have at most 6 submitted candidates, 6 validation requests, 64 total tool calls, 900 seconds and 30000 observed output tokens. Quality is one bundled validation request. Strict Clippy is required, and test timeout must be <=30 seconds. Do not claim tests, safety or integration without recorded evidence. Final hidden evaluation occurs after your run; it is not available through tools.
